title: Representative Python scanner qualification
purpose: Measure finding, call-resolution, control-detection, and deterministic semantic-output accuracy across independently labeled retained repositories.

governance.selection_method: Risk-stratified sample across frameworks, domains, sizes, and architecture styles.
governance.representativeness_rationale: The campaign includes synchronous and asynchronous services, data workflows, and framework-neutral Python selected before scanner results were reviewed.

repositories.selection_rationale: Representative asynchronous service with HTTP and queue boundaries.
